title: Video Downloader For Pinterest
summary: Download images and videos from Pinterest in HD with ease.
description:
Pinload offers a quick and easy way to download videos from Pinterest. Pinload will download images and videos from Pinterest in HD.

Features:

- Easily download videos and images from Pinterest.
- Downloads images and videos from Pinterest Carousel Posts.
- Share the videos to any app directly from the Pinload app.
- Access all your downloaded videos right inside the app.
- Play downloaded videos right from the app.

How to use:

Method - 1 (Recommended)

1. Open the Pinterest post that you want to download.
2. Tap the Share button below the post to open the share sheet.
2. Select Pinload from the list of apps to begin downloading the video or image.

Method - 2

1. Copy the link to the Pinterest post that you want to download.
2. Open the Pinload app and use the clipboard icon to paste the link.
3. Tap on Download to begin downloading the video or image inside the app.
